data.title: Spin the Globe
data.description: Use your compass to explore the great continents and vast oceans on our big map.

challenges.instruction: Find Europe. Spin the globe to look around, then tap it.
Find South America. Spin the globe to look around, then tap it.
Find Asia. Spin the globe to look around, then tap it.
Find North America. Spin the globe to look around, then tap it.
Find the Indian Ocean. Spin the globe to look around, then tap it.
